title: East Village Escape
description:
Our clean, newly renovated East Nashville/Inglewood home is located on a quiet street, just one block (short walk) to a hip coffee shop, deli, pub, restaurant, and record shop. Less than 5 miles (10 min drive/cheap uber) to downtown Nashville, and 7 miles to The Grand Ole Opry.

The space
Live like a local in the desirable East Nashville neighborhood, close to downtown! Stocked with a Keurig coffee machine, shampoo/conditioner, towels, soft sheets, comfortable beds, and full kitchen. Or, if you prefer not to cook, there are great restaurants within walking distance.

Guest access
There are 2 entries to our home, guests will be given the key code upon arrival.

We have always had trouble staying in one place for more than a year, until we found Nashville (which we have called home for almost 10+ years now). We really fell for the East Nashville/Inglewood community and all it has to offer- wonderful people, restaurants, record stores, shops etc. We are both former hockey players from Toronto and Northern New York, and love raising our 3 kiddos here in Nashville. Enjoy your stay in this amazing city!
